name: agentic-commerce-firewall
description: Bounded autonomy for autonomous commerce. AI proposes. Policy decides.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/shared/tsconfig.json && tsc -p packages/protocol/tsconfig.json && tsc -p apps/api/tsconfig.json && tsc -p apps/web/tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.tests.json
